user.title: Area Transit
user.description: Set the global option. Gates are added afterwards, from the integration page.

data_description.inter_gate_window: Maximum time between two transits through contiguous gates for them to be treated as a single journey (A to C via B).

abort.single_instance_allowed: Area Transit is already configured. Add a new gate to the existing entry.

data_description.inter_gate_window: Maximum time between two transits through contiguous gates for them to be treated as a single journey (A to C via B).

user.title: New gate
user.description: A gate connects two areas. The transit is registered only when the sensors fire in order: area A, boundary (if configured), area B.

data_description.name: Shown as the device name of the gate.
data_description.area_in: Area on the A side of the gate.
data_description.area_out: Area on the B side of the gate.
data_description.sensor_in: Binary sensor covering area A next to the gate.
data_description.sensor_out: Binary sensor covering area B next to the gate.
data_description.sensor_boundary: Optional. Once configured it becomes mandatory in the sequence: without it no transit is registered.
data_description.sequence_timeout: Maximum time between the first and the last sensor of the sequence.
data_description.cooldown: Time the gate ignores new events after a registered transit, to avoid double counting.

reset_occupancy.name: Reset occupancy
reset_occupancy.description: Sets the estimated occupancy of the targeted areas to a given value.

reset_counters.name: Reset counters
reset_counters.description: Resets the transit counters, the last transit and the direction of the targeted gates.
